Old game fossil like me that's born in the 80th all know about Saint Seiya as it played a huge part in the raise of anime today. The original manga ran for many many years and they are still releasing new prequel, sequel, standalone and OVA.
It always came back kinda like starwar to their fans.
This is one of the newest game for Saint Seiya and this is a fighting game that can be done with single player and multiplayer.
To Begin let's talk about graphics and animation. Graphics are super Flashy Shining and those different god suits and armors are such epic eye candy that you will love them very much. Different color/variation are availble in this game as collectable. You can choose your character to wear original TV serie color set or manga color set etc.
The characters are also very well draw and bring the sprits of those saints back quite well.
But Graphics of this game are not without it's flaws. IF you look closely on character/suits and etc you often see bad clipping issue. Such as arm get's cut off by hair, arm clips into another arm during animation etc. It seems a bit sloopy to me.
Music is super well compose for this game. Every tone are played like a Symphony and sound effects are superb.
Game play itself are dividing into many different part and not all character are created equal as they are really not.
1. Legend of Cosmos that's 4 story arcs that follows the original Saint Seiya storyline until the end of hades arc.(please note 105 of the Hades specter didn't show up in this game only the big bad 3 did show their face.)
I don't quite like the in between cutscene as it all looks fake and done in very slow pace.
2. Gold Saint god armor which you need to buy torch in collecter to unlock. You have to play each of the 12 gold saints for 3+1 match each to unlock it all and thos armor the best looking in the game.
3. Survival Mode. You pick a character and fight against 3 enemy of your chooseing. Your character HP lost won't be heal in between those 3 fight unless you go for extra challange to get a bit healing. As the difficulty increase the enemy increase from 3 to 5 to 7 to 9 and...
4. Galaxy tournament, Like survival mode you have to unlock each difficulty though each winning tourment between 8 characters but there are 8-9 different type of rule set for each of the tournament and that make unlock them all a big headache.
5. Regular PC vs or Online vs game.
Lot's of collectable such as cloth, stage, character, titles, assist phrase and more make the replayablity very high.
Difficulty vs PC is okish compare to some of the other fighting games I played. IF you careful enough S rank for every fight is very possible as the control of this game is very simple and every move is done with a single button or combonation of 2 buttons. There are some very difficult challange so just complete the regular fight get the golden S rank and redo the battle and go for that challange only.  You need to complete just about all the challange to unlock all the collectable and achivements.
8/10 would be my ranking and It's refreshing to see my childhood heros came to life and does amazing galaxy burning moves. Recommanded for causal fighting game fan and saint seiya fan.

Okay. This game. Gods... I have so much to say about it. And it's all good things as well. So here goes nothing.
Alrighty so first off, the art was amazing. From the characters, to the backgrounds, it all looked so nicely done. And I won't lie, I found it pretty cool how at first almost everyone was just a shadowy figure when it was before Cantus went down to the beach to relax. It was a nice detail. The cute little snowmen guys were also a lovely touch. They made me smile a lot and say stuff like "Aww look at how cute they are"
Next up is the music, and boy did I love it. I found it very relaxing and it was honestly enjoyable to listen to. And most music in any visual novels don't catch my interest unlike in this game. Usually I just have my iTunes in the background. But when I heard the opening for this game, I honestly felt very relaxed and so I gave it a try, and I really liked it.
Now the story. Oh Odin the story. It was so good! I loved how the characters interacted with each other. I found Maris' efforts to make Cantus happy the cutest thing ever. And the way Cantus reacted to Maris' attempts was also very cute. I also was not expecting the ending. Way too many feels. But... I liked it, they were the good kind of feels. Anyways, on a personal note, and like others have already said, I could connect to this on a personal level as well. Due to being bullied up until this year when I moved to Florida and stuff, it's just really understandable since Cantus wasn't liked by the students either. It also told me that by the end, you just have to grow up, move and, and remember that family will always be there for you until the end. My only complaint though is that I wished the main story was a little longer.
So yeah. Loved this game. 10/10 would reccomend to friends :)

SERIOUS REVIEW (Spoiler Alert)
this visual novel tells about an anti-social kid named Cantus who met a strange girl named Maris at the sea.
at the end of the day they met, Maris promised Cantus that she will make Cantus smile in seven days.
the story is beautiful, the characters are lively (even there's only 3, if Gallio doesn't count)
also the realization at the end that what Maris said by her first friend is Cantus's mom made me cry.....
this visual novel is a recommended for people who wants a good story, even this is a bit short (1 hour to be exact) but this touched my heart and made me cry, and those seashells are really beautiful.
Also, it's free to take. So, why don't you take it?
P.S-- I never tried the add-on, going to try later

Voices from the sea has a very nice story and some feels to it even though it's extreamly short it took me about an hour to read through it. I recomend this short VN to anyone who is a fan to the genre and anyone who might be thinking about getting into it.
